bullets.text: same shirt on the third-floor balcony for four days now. rain came twice. it stayed.
duck still at okunoin. overcast, seventeen degrees. cedar roots holding the same stones they held in july.
sorting cables into a box i will not label. next year's problem, already scheduled.
boredom, and underneath it something that isn't boredom. haven't looked closer yet.
the neighbour's dog has decided my footsteps are news. every single time.
